rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: almost none - one scrappy tree in a vacant lot, weeds at fences; a street here lost its trees long ago (zone 109 -> about 30)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (PC session). The block's five builder trees (four ficus and a jacaranda between the cottages) go; one tree comes back.

trees.why: the cottages' one yard tree: it stands 2.2 m behind the bench that faces the swing and the slide, so whoever watches the children sits in its shade. A eucalyptus, a little under full size: seeded from the screen of eucalyptus along the industrial wall just north, and nobody planted it
